scientific_integrity: All 512 candidate words and all compatibility edges are checked exactly; two different representations enumerate and explicitly check the same 62280 maximal cliques, with full catalogue available. Previously studied maximum-size information is not asserted as a separate new result.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact result for binary nine-symbol words only; no asymptotic formula, longer-block classification, or channel-error guarantee. Earlier unindexed complete catalogues are a remaining bibliographic possibility.
title: Complete inclusion-maximality spectrum of binary length-nine cross-bifix-free codes
